title: metadata-protocol: after a restart, two stored rows of one name that each name a different holder leave only the last one loaded, for every package-slotted type (tool, webhook, …)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, measured on `main`. It is filed on the ADR-0150 epic seat's ruling 5 (red-line read 6840825374): #32692 keeps its webhook-only scope, and this widening goes to a card of its own, as asked in 6838938411. The epic seat carried it to triage (6857956853), and PR #33124's body names it as carried.

## What happens

Two packages hold one name of a package-slotted type, for example a `tool` that each ships. The environment has saved one stored row per holder, each row naming its own holder. After the server restarts, the boot hydration (`loadMetaFromDb`) keeps **only the last row loaded**. The other holder's stored customization is no longer served: that package runs its shipped item, with no error or warning. The row is still in the database.

Measured on `main` by the epic red-line read and by os-dev report 6857853868 (PR #33124, scratch merges with `a888c5c9ef` and `2c98485db`): two stored rows, each naming a holder, leave only the last loaded after hydration. This holds for `tool` as well as `webhook`, and by the same code for every `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` type. Since #32741, a *package-less* row is no longer grafted onto a holder; that half is fixed. This card is the remaining case.

## Why it matters

Whoever customised the losing holder's item (an admin, or an agent through MCP: a tool's runtime create is open, so the row need not come from an older release) sees the customization silently revert after every restart. This is the "silently wrong" class #32997 grades as p1. It needs two installed packages holding the same name, both with a stored row.

## Do

- Key the hydration's artifact and slot lookup by `(package, name)` for every `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` type, so each stored row lands in its own holder's slot (ADR-0150 D3/D4).
- Add a pin over at least `tool` and `webhook`: two holders, one stored row each, both load orders, then a restart. Each exact address serves its own row, and the bare read refuses 409 naming both.
- Coordinate with #32692 (webhook, in flight). If its fix is the same lookup, land it there once and use this card for the remaining types and the pin.

## Reader

`domain:server`. ADR-0150's red lines apply: resolution is never loosened, ambiguity is reported and never guessed, and the change is independently releasable.

## Dedupe

`boot hydration two stored rows holder`: only #32692 (webhook scope, by ruling). `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES hydration`: 0 open. `loadMetaFromDb last loaded`: 0 open.
